properties.description: A synchronous reset edge clears both response valids. Reset cancels scoreboard obligations without checking unspecified invalid payloads or prescribing input ready.
A blocked data presentation retains valid, byte and last through subsequent edges, except when reset cancels it.
A blocked status presentation retains valid and all status fields independently of the data channel, except on reset.

Every presented data beat is justified by an accepted prefix or completed-frame padding, including blocked presentations. After 128 uninterrupted no-offer, both-ready cycles, bounded tracked obligations must be drained.
Presented justified data preserves byte order, pads short frames with zeros to four bytes, truncates at eight bytes and marks exactly the expected final byte.

Each presented status belongs to the next completed accepted frame and reports its original length, clamped length and exact padding/truncation flags. Status retirement is independent of data retirement.
